completion_decisions: Retain all four paper problems, both wake-model families, WEC-D stages, final local-TI treatment, and all 200 common public starts.
Encode the factual public arrays in a provenance-pinned binary fixture because the paper-linked repository has no license file.
Resolve Case-1 speed and ALPSO population conflicts paper-first as 10 m/s and 30 particles; retain model-lineage-specific shear behavior.
Use fixed-width forward AD and analytic constraint Jacobians with pinned NLopt SLSQP as an open replacement for SNOPT.
Independently reconstruct augmented-Lagrangian PSO with the paper inner/outer schedules and exact complete-layout call budgets.
Parallelize wind states for SLSQP and complete particles for ALPSO with one persistent pure-C++ worker team and fixed-order reductions.
Execute the 16 final Tables 5-9 roles for all 200 starts; retain WEC-A/WEC-H tuning and prior-literature comparisons as diagnostics.
missing_information: Tapenade and pyOptSparse ALPSO environment revisions
exact random states and complete dependency environment
machine-readable optimized layouts and complete convergence histories

paper.authors: Jared J. Thomas and Spencer McOmber and Andrew Ning
paper.title: Wake Expansion Continuation: Multi-Modality Reduction in the Wind Farm Layout Optimization Problem

paper_source_conflicts: Case 1 is 10 m/s in paper Section 5.1 but 8 m/s in the public input/final source run; paper-first 10 m/s is implemented and the source Case-1 result is excluded as a numeric oracle.
Older public ALPSO drivers use population 25 while Table 3 and final drivers use 30; paper/final-driver value 30 is implemented.
Jensen3D consumes tabulated speed directly while PlantEnergy Bastankhah applies 80-to-70 m shear; model-specific source semantics are retained.
Public starts use the paper-described 1D separation while final layouts require 2D spacing; both lifecycle rules are retained.

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reproduction of WEC-D, all four target problems, final 16 algorithm-problem roles, and 200-start protocol; not author solver, environment, random stream, or trajectory replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: final layouts enforce 160 m 2D spacing and square, circle, or 14-facet polygon boundaries; feasible incumbents are retained

decision_variables.resolution: continuous x/y coordinates for 16, 38, 38, or 60 Vestas V80 turbines

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: direct double-precision coordinate vectors; no discrete decoder

initialization.resolution: all 200 public square, round, and Amalia starting coordinate arrays are preserved; their paper-described 1D separation is not rewritten

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: 16 final Tables 5-9 roles times 200 common starts; AEP, wake loss, feasibility, call ledger, timings, worker receipt, hashes, and layouts

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize probability-weighted annual energy production through minimization of its negative in SLSQP or penalized negative in ALPSO

paper_native_cases.resolution: all four 16/20, 38/12, 38/36, and 60/72 turbine/wind-state cases and the reported Case-2 Jensen variant are registered

parameters.resolution: WEC-D 3.0 to 1.0 schedule, ALPSO population 30 and paper call schedules, paper tolerances, and 220 SLSQP safety-cap evaluations per stage

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: ALPSO executes exact paper complete-layout call budgets; SLSQP stops by declared open-solver tolerance or 220-stage safety cap and records actual objective calls

update_order.resolution: continuation, solver, PSO, multiplier, and best-state commits remain ordered; wind-state and particle outputs use fixed slots

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: independent pure-C++ Bastankhah-Niayifar/local-TI and Jensen-cosine/Katic evaluators with tabulated V80 power/CT and model-specific speed-height semantics

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: 20, 12, 36, and 72 fixed published/source wind states; Case 1 uses paper-first 10 m/s and Cases 2/3 preserve mass 0.962 without renormalization
